_comment: Scheduler config. State files live next to this file. Pool sizes are intentionally tiny — fork and fill.

heartbeat_rhythm._comment: Adaptive intervals. day_hours[0] <= current_hour < day_hours[1] counts as day.

weather_detector._comment_significant: Weather kind transitions among these keywords are treated as significant.

morning_news._comment: Once per day, at a uniformly random time in [window_start_hour, window_end_hour). Yields to same-tick manual/weather and gives up the day; never makes up a missed firing.

calendar_event._comment: Runs once daily at 00:30 to check solar terms / festivals. Requires `zhdate` for lunar festival lookup (pip install zhdate).

mail_detector._comment: Disabled by default. Set credentials via .env (IMAP_HOST / IMAP_PORT / IMAP_USER / IMAP_PASS) and flip enabled=true.

_comment_notifier: Which notifier in notifiers/ to load. 'telegram' (default), 'stdout' (no external delivery, prints to console). Implement your own by subclassing Notifier in notifiers/ and adding a load entry to notifiers/__init__.py.

notifier_config._comment_telegram: Telegram notifier reads its credentials from environment variables (see .env.example). Only the non-secret settings live here.

perturbation_imagery._comment: trigger → hint pool. Each pool keeps 2 examples in this open-source release; fill out in your fork. Scheduled fires write null hint and the room renderer skips that layer for them.
event:weather:rain: The light outside just changed — rain.
event:weather:sunny: The clouds opened, sun on the boards.
event:weather:fog: The window's gone white with mist.
event:weather:mist: The view's softened with damp air.
morning_news: Morning. The world's been busy while you weren't looking.
